fullPassage: Curiosity is the essence of life. Animals including humans cannot live without knowing what is useful to them and what is needed for their survival: where to find food, how to avoid predators, where to find mates, etc. However, the human species differs from other animals because we thirst for knowledge that reaches far beyond our personal needs. We look around us and we wonder. We wonder about our surroundings and about what we observe both near and far and we want to understand it all. Indeed, we fear the unknown. This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only makes us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization.

다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the strong desire to know or learn about something, often leading to exploration and discovery"

det.korean: 정의 '무언가를 알거나 배우려는 강한 욕구, 흔히 탐구로 이어지는' = curiosity(호기심).
det.analysis:
❌ ① desire(욕구): 그냥 '욕구'로는 '알고 배우려는'이라는 한정을 담지 못해 틀려요.

❌ ② survival(생존): 생존을 뜻해 정의와 무관해요.

❌ ③ foundation(토대): 토대를 뜻해 정의와 맞지 않아요.

✅ ④ curiosity(호기심): '알거나 배우려는 강한 욕구'라는 정의와 정확히 일치해요. ← 정답
det.tip: strong desire to know or learn(알고 배우려는 강한 욕구) → curiosity

questions.passage: Animals including humans cannot live without __________ (know) what is useful to them and what is needed for their survival.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

Animals including humans cannot live without __________ (know) what is useful to them.

det.korean: know(원형) → knowing. 전치사 without 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 전치사 without(~없이)이 있어요. 전치사 뒤에는 명사나 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로 know에 -ing를 붙인 knowing(아는 것)이 돼요. 'without knowing'(알지 못한 채)이라는 뜻이에요.

questions.passage: This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only __________ (make) us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only __________ (make) us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization.

det.korean: make(원형) → makes. 주어 'This sense of wonder and desire'의 핵심이 단수(sense)이고 현재 시제라 3인칭 단수형.
det.analysis: 주어 'This sense of wonder and desire for understanding'는 하나의 '감각(sense)'을 가리켜 단수로 취급해요. 현재 시제이므로 make에 -s를 붙인 3인칭 단수형 makes(만든다)가 돼요.

questions.passage: Curiosity is the essence of life. Animals including humans cannot live without knowing what is useful to them and what is needed for their survival: where to find food, how to avoid predators, where to find mates, etc. However, the human species differs from other animals because we thirst for knowledge that reaches __________. We look around us and we wonder. We wonder about our surroundings and about what we observe both near and far and we want to understand it all. Indeed, we fear the unknown. This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only makes us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: far beyond our personal needs(개인적 필요를 훨씬 넘어서는) — 인간이 갈망하는 지식의 범위.
det.analysis:
❌ ① without knowing what is useful(유용한 것을 모른 채): 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않아 틀려요.

✅ ② far beyond our personal needs(개인적 필요를 훨씬 넘어서): 원문 'knowledge that reaches ___'(~에 이르는 지식)에 이어지는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ③ focused only on finding food and mates(먹이와 짝 찾기에만 집중된): 동물 수준의 설명이라 인간과 반대라 틀려요.

❌ ④ determined by our genetic makeup(유전자로 결정되는): 본문에 없는 내용이라 틀려요.
det.tip: knowledge that reaches far beyond our personal needs = 개인적 필요를 넘어서는 지식

ch: focused only on finding food and mates

Animals including humans cannot live without knowing what is useful to them and what is needed for their survival: where to find food, how to avoid predators, where to find mates, etc. However, the human species differs from other animals because we thirst for knowledge that reaches far beyond our personal needs. We look around us and we wonder. We wonder about our surroundings and about what we observe both near and far and we want to understand it all. Indeed, we fear the unknown. This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only makes us human, but is also __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: one of the foundation stones of civilization(문명의 토대 중 하나) — 경이감과 이해 욕구의 역할.
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoid predators, where to find mates, etc(포식자를 피하고 짝을 찾는 것): 동물 수준의 설명이라 문맥과 맞지 않아 틀려요.

❌ ② the primary cause of conflict between species(종 간 갈등의 주원인): 본문에 없는 내용이라 틀려요.

✅ ③ one of the foundation stones of civilization(문명의 토대 중 하나): 원문 'is also ___'(또한 ___이다)에 이어지는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ④ an obstacle to practical problem-solving(실용적 문제 해결의 장애물): 긍정적 역할과 반대라 틀려요.
det.tip: one of the foundation stones of civilization = 문명의 토대 중 하나
